question: Who among the following became Member of Legislative Assembly from Gopalganj, Bihar in India, in November 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Kusum Devi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ** The correct answer is option 2, Kusum Devi, who became a Member of the Legislative Assembly from Gopalganj, Bihar in November 2022.**

 
 
• Nitish Kumar, option 1, is the current Chief Minister of Bihar.
 
• He was elected as the Chief Minister for the fourth consecutive term in November 2020.
 
 
 
• Lalmuni Chaubey, option 3, is a member of the Bihar Legislative Council.
 
 
• He was elected as a Member of the Legislative Council from the Teachers' Constituency in 2020.
 
 
 
• Narendra Modi, option 4, is the current Prime Minister of India.
 
 
• He is not a member of the Bihar Legislative Assembly.
 
 
 
• **Hence, the correct answer is option 2, Kusum Devi, who became a Member of the Legislative Assembly from Gopalganj, Bihar in November 2022.**
